critical_boundaries.count_identity: Ray/shell/ball/triangle/parallelogram counts are exact, but scaffold-only counts are unchanged across staircase coordinate maps. No independent relation currently couples n to a region count at a_n.
critical_boundaries.cyclic_reduction: Cyclic covariance is an explicit subcase and reduces the three functions to one F; it is not a hard observation.
critical_boundaries.five: Both a_5=2 and a_5=3 occur in complete square-root schedule atlases; 5->4/9 remains unresolved.
critical_boundaries.general_solution: Without symmetry assumptions, UNIT_STEP atlases are exactly U=a+F(b), V=-b+G(a), W=-a+H(a+b) with one-dimensional 0/1-type finite differences.
critical_boundaries.inversion: Global inversion is compatible with the minimal +u-only control but incompatible with hard +u plus cyclic UNIT_STEP semantics.
critical_boundaries.root_schedules: For p=2..6 each perfect-power interval admits an arbitrary single jump position; local UNIT_STEP equations identify neither root order nor lower/upper schedule.
critical_boundaries.staircase: With the explicit u-ray reflection, every global atlas is in bijection with a_0=0,a_1=1 and arbitrary increments a_(n+1)-a_n in {0,1}. Local consistency does not locate the jumps.
critical_boundaries.universality: No universal BRC law, physical probability, physical geometry, physical direction preference, force/energy, or physical dimensionality is established.
